```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Read in your Excel file
df <- read_excel("morph_clean.xlsx")

# Clean column names (replace spaces and dots with underscores)
names(df) <- gsub(" |\\.", "_", names(df))

# Summarize data by Location, Life Stage, and Variety
summary_table <- df %>%
  group_by(location, Life_S, variety) %>%
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    mean_height = mean(height_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_blade_width = mean(bladewidth_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_divisions = mean(divisions, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dry_weight = mean(dry_weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Print summary table
print(summary_table)
write.csv(summary_table, file = "output/plots_morph/morphometric_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Function to summarize height statistics
summarize_height <- function(data, group_var) {
  data %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_height = mean(height_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q1 = quantile(height_cm, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median = quantile(height_cm, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q3 = quantile(height_cm, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Ensure output directory exists
output_dir <- "output/plots_morph"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Summary by variety
height_by_variety <- summarize_height(df, "variety")
cat("\n--- Height Summary by Variety ---\n")
print(height_by_variety)
write.csv(height_by_variety, file = file.path(output_dir, "height_summary_by_variety.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Summary by Life Stage
height_by_life <- summarize_height(df, "Life_S")
cat("\n--- Height Summary by Life Stage ---\n")
print(height_by_life)
write.csv(height_by_life, file = file.path(output_dir, "height_summary_by_life_stage.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Summary by Location
height_by_location <- summarize_height(df, "location")
cat("\n--- Height Summary by Location ---\n")
print(height_by_location)
write.csv(height_by_location, file = file.path(output_dir, "height_summary_by_location.csv"), row.names = FALSE)


```
#Panel plot
```{r}
# 1. Filter your data
df_filtered <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(location %in% c("Mendieta", "7H", "Caro Caido")) %>%
  mutate(
    Life_S = case_when(
      Life_S %in% c("Gam", "Tetra", "Gam/Tetra") ~ "Gam/Tetra",
      Life_S == "Carp" ~ "Carp",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Life_S))  # Remove Unknown and anything else recoded as NA
# 2. Color palette (by Life Stage)
group_colors <- c(
  "Gam/Tetra" = "#33a02c",  # Green (unchanged)
  "Carp"      = "#7b1f52"   # Dark reddish-purple
)

# 3. Y-axis display names
display_names <- c(
  "height_cm" = "Height (cm)",
  "dry_weight" = "Dry Weight (g)",
  "bladewidth_mm" = "Blade Width (mm)"
)
#Outliers function
replace_outliers_multi <- function(df, vars, group_vars = c("variety", "Life_S")) {
  for (var in vars) {
    df <- df %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
      mutate(
        Q1 = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q3 = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
        IQR = Q3 - Q1,
        lower = Q1 - 2 * IQR,
        upper = Q3 + 2 * IQR,
        "{var}" := ifelse(.data[[var]] < lower | .data[[var]] > upper, NA, .data[[var]])
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::select(-Q1, -Q3, -IQR, -lower, -upper)
  }
  return(df)
}

# Use on your cleaned + filtered data
df_cleaned <- replace_outliers_multi(
  df_filtered,
  vars = c("height_cm", "dry_weight", "bladewidth_mm")
)

make_morph_plot <- function(data, yvar) {
  ysym <- rlang::sym(yvar)
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = variety, y = !!ysym, fill = Life_S)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = Life_S),
                position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.75),
                alpha = 0.9, size = 2.5, shape = 16) +  # Increased size
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    labs(y = display_names[[yvar]]) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +  # Increased base font size
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x       = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 20)),
      axis.text.x        = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.ticks.x       = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y       = element_line(size = 1),
      axis.line.x        = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y        = element_line(size = 1),
      legend.position    = "none",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )
}

Style_plot_bottom_row <- function(p) {
  p + theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 24, face = "bold",
      margin = margin(t = 20)  # add more space above title
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 20, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = 10)  # add space below text
    ),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(size = 1),
    axis.line.x  = element_line(size = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(b = 20, t = 10, l = 10, r = 10)  # extra space around the plot
  )
}

# 6. Generate plots
plot_vars <- c("height_cm", "dry_weight", "bladewidth_mm")
plots_morph <- lapply(plot_vars, function(var) make_morph_plot(df_filtered, var))
names(plots_morph) <- plot_vars

# 7. Apply bottom style to last row
if (length(plots_morph) >= 1) {
  plots_morph[[length(plots_morph)]] <- style_plot_bottom_row(plots_morph[[length(plots_morph)]])
}

# 8. Combine plots
full_panel <- wrap_plots(plots_morph, ncol = 1)

# 9. Save
ggsave("output_all/plots/morphometric_panel_filtered.png",
       full_panel, width = 10, height = 15, dpi = 300)

# 10. Optional: legend
legend_plot <- make_morph_plot(df_filtered, "height_cm") +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Life Stage"))

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)

ggsave("output_all/plots/morphometric_legend.png",
       plot = cowplot::plot_grid(legend), width = 4, height = 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

```
